title: Collagen membranes of dermal and pericardial origin -In vivo evolvement of vascularization over time
authors: Dau M, Volprich L, Grambow E, Vollmar B, Frerich B, Al -Nawas B, Kämmerer PW. J Biomed Mater Res A. 2020 Dec;108(12):2368-2378. doi: 10.1002/jbm.a.36989.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collprotect (porcine dermis) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “, dermal bilayer as well as pericardial CM seem to have a higher vascularization rate than dermal homogenous CM. Additional coating of pericardial CM with a silica -enhanced hydroxyapatite increases the speed of vascularization as well as biological remodeling processes” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
